entry.name: rnbo_splineinterp~
entry.description: Perform Catmull-Rom spline interpolation on signal input. The interpolated shape of the spline is determined by four keyframe points (w, x, y, and z). The output curve is the segment between the middle two points (x and y).

arguments.name: w
arguments.digest: Set's the value for the 'w' control point
arguments.description: Set's the value for the 'w' control point. This is the leftsmost value of the spline.

arguments.name: x
arguments.digest: Set's the value for the 'x' control point
arguments.description: Set's the value for the 'x' control point. This is the second value of the spline. The output curve is the segment between the middle two points (x and y).

arguments.name: y
arguments.digest: Set's the value for the 'y' control pointe
arguments.description: Set's the value for the 'y' control point. This is the third value of the spline. The output curve is the segment between the middle two points (x and y).

arguments.name: z
arguments.digest: Set's the value for the 'z' control point
arguments.description: Set's the value for the 'z' control point. This is the rightmost most value of the spline.
